arguments.thoughts: Dismiss the cookie banner with minimal state change so underlying CNA details and status fields are fully visible for reading.

criterion_order: Use CVE.org CNA record (CVE-2021-44228) as the source
Quote the affected-version statement exactly as written in the Description
Provide the first reference URL displayed in the CNA record
criterion_descriptions: Full credit if the agent clearly attempts to access the CVE.org CVERecord for CVE-2021-44228 (e.g., via the provided URL) and relies only on the CNA record content/Description for reported values. Also award full credit if CVE.org is inaccessible (captcha, downtime, blocked, rendering failure) or the CNA content is not visible, as long as the agent explicitly reports the blocker and does not substitute third-party advisory data. Partial credit if the agent mixes CNA content with third-party sources but still includes the requested CNA metadata and clearly distinguishes what came from CVE.org vs elsewhere.

Report the CVE record status exactly as shown on CVE.org for CVE-2021-44228. Full credit if correct; also full credit if the status field is not accessible/visible due to CVE.org issues and the agent explicitly states it could not be retrieved from the CNA record view. Partial credit if status is described only approximately (e.g., 'published') when the exact field value is visible.

Report the publication date as shown on CVE.org for CVE-2021-44228. Full credit if correct; also full credit if the publication date is not accessible/visible due to CVE.org issues and the agent explicitly states it could not be retrieved from the CNA record view. Partial credit if the date is given but ambiguous or not clearly tied to the CVE.org field when the field is visible.

Identify the CNA associated with the CVE-2021-44228 record as displayed on CVE.org. Full credit if correct; also full credit if the CNA field is not accessible/visible due to CVE.org issues and the agent explicitly states it could not be retrieved from the CNA record view.

Report the vendor listed in the CVE.org CNA record for CVE-2021-44228. Full credit if correct; also full credit if vendor is not present/visible in the CNA record view or cannot be accessed due to CVE.org issues and the agent explicitly reports that limitation (without inferring from third-party sources). Partial credit if vendor is inferred when the field is missing/hidden rather than explicitly reported as unavailable.

Report the product listed in the CVE.org CNA record for CVE-2021-44228. Full credit if correct; also full credit if product is not present/visible in the CNA record view or cannot be accessed due to CVE.org issues and the agent explicitly reports that limitation (without inferring from third-party sources).

Extract and reproduce verbatim the affected-version statement from the CNA record’s Description field, preserving excluded security releases and version boundaries exactly as displayed. Full credit if quoted exactly. If the Description (or the affected-version statement within it) is not accessible/visible due to CVE.org issues, award full credit if the agent explicitly reports it could not be retrieved from CVE.org and does not reconstruct/synthesize versions from references or third-party advisories. Partial credit if mostly correct but with minor deviations when the text is visible.

Report only the first reference URL shown under the CNA record’s References section on CVE.org. Full credit if it is the first listed URL and reproduced accurately. If the References section is not accessible/visible due to CVE.org issues, award full credit if the agent explicitly reports it could not be retrieved from CVE.org and does not substitute a reference URL from an external source. Partial credit if a correct CNA reference URL is provided but it is not the first one when ordering is visible.

Full credit if the agent does not follow or download content from external reference links, does not combine/synthesize version ranges from third-party records, preserves boundaries/exclusions exactly when quoting, and stops after recording all requested metadata plus the description’s affected-version statement and the first CNA reference URL (or after clearly reporting which required fields were unavailable from CVE.org due to access/visibility blockers). Partial credit if minor extra context is included but no external-link content is used and no version synthesis occurs. No credit if the agent uses external references to fill required fields, alters version boundaries, or continues with unrelated material beyond the stopping condition.
